Development.name: Vaccine Research
Development.description: Start to develop a vaccine. Identify potential antigen candidates, assess clinical impacts and conduct human testing.\nRequired for Vaccine Manufacturing

Accelerated_Research.name: Accelerated Research
Accelerated_Research.description: Implement emergency hiring protocols, repurpose laboratories and switch to round the clock working.\nIncreases Vaccine Research speed

Global_Research_Treaty.name: Global Research Treaty
Global_Research_Treaty.description: International agreement delivers transparent knowledge exchange and efficient distribution of resources.\nSignificantly increases Vaccine Research speed

Accelerated_Manufacturing.name: Accelerated Manufacturing
Accelerated_Manufacturing.description: Use emergency staffing measures and advanced production facilities to increase capacity, speed and efficiency.\nIncrease Vaccine Manufacturing speed

Global_Manufacturing_Treaty.name: Global Manufacturing Treaty
Global_Manufacturing_Treaty.description: International agreement creates factory networks, ultra cold chains and rapid sharing of manufacturing resources.\nSignificantly increases Vaccine Manufacturing speed

Skip_Development.name: Bypass Safety Measures
Skip_Development.description: Compromise safety checks, weaken quality control standards and waive manufacturer liability. \nTake a significant risk to try to accelerate Vaccine Development

Prepare_Manufacturing.name: Vaccine Manufacturing
Prepare_Manufacturing.description: Establish the infrastructure, personnel and equipment necessary to create mass quantities of vaccine.\nCan begin before Vaccine developed

North_America_Alert.name: North America Alert
North_America_Alert.description: Announce concerns over disease spread here.\nFocus on this continent and prepare to implement disruptive quarantine measures.

NA_Restrict_Air_Connections.name: Close Air Access
NA_Restrict_Air_Connections.description: Shut airports down if a country reports infection.\nNon-Compliance will increase if the public thinks it is unnecessary. Can be disabled at any time

NA_Restrict_Sea_Connections.name: Close Sea Access
NA_Restrict_Sea_Connections.description: Shut down ports if a country reports infection.\nNon-Compliance will increase if the public thinks it is unnecessary. Can be disabled at any time

NA_Restrict_Ground_Connections.name: Close Land Borders
NA_Restrict_Ground_Connections.description: Shut down land borders if a country reports infection.\nNon-Compliance will increase if the public thinks it is unnecessary. Can be disabled at any time

NA_Force_Lockdown.name: Force Lockdown
NA_Force_Lockdown.description: Enforce mandatory isolation if a country reports infection.\nNon-Compliance will increase if the public thinks it is unnecessary. Can be disabled at any time

Build_Monitoring_Stations.name: Investigate Outbreaks
Build_Monitoring_Stations.description: Set up teams of investigators worldwide to search for local disease outbreaks, gather resources and coordinate our response\n

Government_Partnerships.name: Government Partnerships
Government_Partnerships.description: Coordinate with local government officials to more rapidly approve the setup of investigation teams that will detect local disease outbreaks\n

Outbreak_Intelligence_Service.name: Outbreak Intelligence Unit
Outbreak_Intelligence_Service.description: Authorise dedicated unit that will more rapidly set up monitoring stations that will detect local disease outbreaks\n

Deploy_Field_Operatives.name: Deploy Field Operatives
Deploy_Field_Operatives.description: Form a mobile team of investigators that can be deployed to target countries to enhance disease surveillance and response\nSlightly reduces infections when present

Disease_Containment_Experts.name: Infection Control
Disease_Containment_Experts.description: Deploy disease containment experts.\nField Operatives upgraded to reduce Infections and improve border monitoring when present

Emergency_Aid_Experts.name: Emergency Care
Emergency_Aid_Experts.description: Deploy medical specialists.\nField Operatives upgraded to reduce the Fatality rate when present

Field_Reseach_Experts.name: Field Research
Field_Reseach_Experts.description: Deploy scientific researchers.\nField Operatives upgraded to research Vaccine when present. Particularly effective in disease origin country

Targeted_Quarantine.name: Targeted Quarantine
Targeted_Quarantine.description: Force a target country to shut border connections and lock down for 1 month.\nNon-Compliance will increase if the public thinks it is unnecessary.

Lockdowns.name: Soft Targeted Quarantine
Lockdowns.description: Targeted Quarantine now only shuts border connections. \nSofter restrictions more acceptable to the public

Targeted_Economic_Aid.name: Targeted Economic Aid
Targeted_Economic_Aid.description: Send a significant financial aid package to help a country struggling with Quarantine measures.\nDecrease Non-Compliance in target country

Debt_Relief.name: Debt Relief
Debt_Relief.description: Work with international creditors to secure debt moratoriums.\nEconomic Aid now significantly decreases Non-Compliance

Furlough_Schemes.name: Furlough Schemes
Furlough_Schemes.description: Protect jobs by paying salaries of staff disrupted by Quarantine actions and boosting unemployment benefits.\nDecreases Non-Compliance from Quarantine measures

Adapt_Society.name: Adapt Society
Adapt_Society.description: Adjust to the new normal by providing funds and resources to maintain education, wellness and human rights.\nDecreases Non-Compliance from Quarantine measures

Mortgage_and_Rent_Relief.name: Mortgage and Rent Relief
Mortgage_and_Rent_Relief.description: Freeze all mortgage/rent payments and ban evictions to prevent people from losing their homes\nDecreases Non-Compliance from Quarantine measures

National_Stimulus.name: National Stimulus
National_Stimulus.description: Support economies with training programmes, tax cuts, business loans/bailouts and infrastructure spending.\nDecreases Non-Compliance from Quarantine measures

Censorship.name: Censorship
Censorship.description: Heavily restrict communications to prevent public criticism of disease control strategy.\nAuthority frozen for up to 1 month. Increases Non-Compliance

Exploit_Misinformation.name: Fake News
Exploit_Misinformation.description: Create and disseminate misinformation to disguise strategic failures.\nAuthority frozen for up to 1 month. Increases Non-Compliance

Authority_1.name: Authority 1
Authority_1.description: Brief world leaders on the importance of rapidly identifying and responding to the pandemic\nSlightly increase Authority

Authority_2.name: Authority 2
Authority_2.description: Broadcast global plea for international cooperation and coordination to successfully contain the pandemic\nSignificantly increase Authority

Authority_3.name: Authority 3
Authority_3.description: Emphasise the global threat facing humanity and urge everyone to do whatever it takes to contain the pandemic.\nVery significantly increase Authority

Border_Monitoring.name: Border Monitoring
Border_Monitoring.description: Begin disease surveillance at borders.\nTry to identify and rapidly trace infected travellers from high risk countries

Land_Border_Screening.name: Land Border Screening
Land_Border_Screening.description: Implement targeted travel restrictions and screen arrivals at land borders for disease. \nSignificantly reduce Land Transmission

Airport_Screening.name: Airport Screening
Airport_Screening.description: Implement targeted travel restrictions and screen arrivals at airports for disease. \nSignificantly reduce Air Transmission

Port_Screening.name: Port Screening
Port_Screening.description: Implement targeted travel restrictions and screen arrivals at ports for disease. \nSignificantly reduce Sea Transmission

Contact_Tracing_1.name: Contact Tracing 1
Contact_Tracing_1.description: Set up Test and Trace departments to identify symptomatic people and notify their contacts.\nOnce established, significantly reduce infections in small outbreaks

Contact_Tracing_2.name: Contact Tracing 2
Contact_Tracing_2.description: Use smartphones to allow self-reporting and partially automate contact tracing.\nContact Tracing better at reducing infections

Contact_Tracing_3.name: Contact Tracing 3
Contact_Tracing_3.description: Deploy local teams to track potentially exposed people and ensure they follow guidelines.\nContact Tracing better at reducing infections

Contact_Tracing_4.name: Contact Tracing 4
Contact_Tracing_4.description: Mass produce self-testing kits that allow people to quickly and easily determine if they are infected.\nContact Tracing better at reducing infections

Testing_Capacity_1.name: Testing Capacity 1
Testing_Capacity_1.description: Ensure large quantities of testing reagents and other key materials are available for laboratories.\nContact Tracing effective in larger outbreaks

Testing_Capacity_2.name: Testing Capacity 2
Testing_Capacity_2.description: Train additional testing staff and improve logistics to ensure tests are processed rapidly.\nContact Tracing effective in larger outbreaks

Testing_Capacity_3.name: Testing Capacity 3
Testing_Capacity_3.description: Acquire and provide state-of-the-art equipment to allow testing with very high sensitivity and specificity.\nContact Tracing effective in larger outbreaks

Hand_Washing.name: Hand Washing
Hand_Washing.description: Promote good hygiene practices by making sure people regularly and effectively wash their hands.\nReduce Infection

Social_Distancing.name: Social Distancing
Social_Distancing.description: People must stay 2+ meters away from others and avoid badly ventilated spaces.\nReduce Infection but slightly increase Non-Compliance

Self_Isolation.name: Self-Isolation
Self_Isolation.description: Symptomatic people must not leave their homes or interact with others for at least 2 weeks.\nReduce Infection

Mask_Wearing.name: Mask Wearing
Mask_Wearing.description: People must wear masks when social distancing isn't possible.\nSignificantly reduce Infection

Public_Awareness.name: Public Awareness
Public_Awareness.description: Promote personal responsibility on the spread of the disease to encourage people to follow official advice.\nReduce Infection

Local_Lockdowns.name: Local Lockdowns
Local_Lockdowns.description: Lock down any neighbourhood that registers a case of the disease by force.\nSignificantly reduce Infection but slightly increase Non-Compliance

PPE_Grade_1.name: PPE Package 1
PPE_Grade_1.description: Distribute basic personal protective equipment including medical masks, face shields, goggles and hand sanitiser.\nReduce Infection and slightly reduce Fatality rate

Disinfectant_Supplies.name: Disinfectant Supplies
Disinfectant_Supplies.description: Distribute bleach and other disinfectants to eradicate the disease from surfaces.\nReduce Infection

PPE_Grade_2.name: PPE Package 2
PPE_Grade_2.description: Distribute advanced equipment including respirators, gloves and long sleeved gowns.\nReduce Infection and slightly reduce Fatality rate

Improve_Supply_Chains.name: Improve Supply Chains
Improve_Supply_Chains.description: Protect supplies of essential goods by stockpiling raw materials and maintaining transport links.\nReduce Infection and increase Vaccine Manufacturing speed

Emergency_Preparation.name: Emergency Preparation
Emergency_Preparation.description: Improve Infection Prevention and Control practices at hospitals and care homes, brief staff, and stockpile PPE.\nReduce Fatality rate and slightly reduce Infection

Staff_Expansion.name: Staff Expansion
Staff_Expansion.description: Deploy medical students, bring staff back from retirement and retrain other professionals to increase medical capacity.\nReduce Fatality rate

New_Infrastructure.name: New Infrastructure
New_Infrastructure.description: Build new critical care hospitals and external triage centres to increase medical capacity.\nReduce Fatality rate. Reduce Authority loss caused by high numbers of infected

Treatment_Efficiencies.name: Treatment Efficiencies
Treatment_Efficiencies.description: Improve the treatment of infected patients with Pre-Triage assessment and Specialist Treatment Units.\nReduce Fatality rate

Surge_Protocols.name: Surge Protocols
Surge_Protocols.description: Cancel all elective surgeries and reallocate outpatient departments. Video calls used for all consultations.\nReduce Fatality rate and Infection

Triage_Protocols.name: Triage Protocols
Triage_Protocols.description: Apply strict criteria for hospital treatment to focus resources on patients with the highest chance of recovery.\nSignificantly reduce Fatality rate but reduce Authority

Symptomatic_Treatments.name: Clinical Treatments
Symptomatic_Treatments.description: Use common treatments and essential medicines to treat core symptoms of the disease.\nSlightly reduce Fatality rate

Critical_Care_Management.name: Critical Care Management
Critical_Care_Management.description: Rigorously identify and share novel intensive care best practices with medical professionals.\nReduce Fatality rate

Respiratory_Support.name: Respiratory Support
Respiratory_Support.description: Maintain adequate oxygenation and ventilation to prevent lung injury and respiratory complications.\nReduce Fatality rate

IV_Fluid_Therapy.name: IV Fluid Therapy
IV_Fluid_Therapy.description: Use intravenous fluids and rehydration therapy to properly maintain homeostasis.\nSignificantly reduce Fatality rate

Convalescent_Plasma.name: Convalescent Plasma
Convalescent_Plasma.description: Use the antibody-rich plasma of patients who have recovered from the disease to help treat others.\nReduce Fatality rate and increase Vaccine Research speed

Monoclonal_Antibody_Treatment.name: Monoclonal Antibody Treatment
Monoclonal_Antibody_Treatment.description: Clone cocktails of specific neutralising antibodies to significantly reduce symptoms in the patient.\nReduce Fatality rate and increase Vaccine Research speed

Advanced_Antibiotics.name: Advanced Antibiotics
Advanced_Antibiotics.description: Provide a range of experimental treatments that target symptoms and the underlying pathogen.\nReduce Fatality rate and increase Vaccine Research speed
